Data:Musictrack.aknowledgeinthelookofthi.label: 'A Knowledge in the Look of Things'

Data:Mwis.json.label: Wist: Shell-Crossed
Data:Mwis.json.desc: My thoughts are tangled and unfamiliar to me. Something of those who came before - the Carapace Cross - has always lingered in humankind. It's risen now in me.

xexts.malady．inflicting: I've over-tired myself. My thoughts are crabbed and strange. [Your Wist has a Malady.]
xexts.contamination．witchworms: When I bend too close to this, I hear a faint whispering. An infestation: witchworms! [Your Wist has suffered from the whispering of worms; this item is infested.]
xexts.contamination．winkwell: There are eyes here, half-visible, winking coyly at me. A winkwell infection. I keep thinking of those eyes when I close my own. [Your Wist has a Malady; this item is corrupted.]
